text:
Nina.AE: Quick thread for DeepHarbor POC. Customer wants to validate running tidal-30b (new upstream) inside their VPC with KV prefix caching + BYO HSM. Target ~10 qps sustained. Need compatibility checklist, timeline, and a pricing ballpark. Any immediate blockers?

Raj.SE: First pass: tidal-30b uses RMSNorm + fused attention with grouped_gemm-like ops. Can we quantize to q8_0 / q4_0? @Maya.ML?

Maya.ML: We can do q8_0 with slight model export tweaks. Fused attention needs a kernel patch present in runtime >= 2.4.0. If their runtime is older we'll need to recompile runtime or use container with patched runtime. Conversion+quantize+compile+smoke perf = ~3 business days.

Priya.Infra: On-prem/VPC checklist: NVIDIA driver >=525, CUDA >=12.1, container runtime >=1.6, and pkcs11 libs for HSM. If they want zero-egress, we must ensure image registry access or air-gapped image delivery. I'll open infra-validation ticket.

Nina.AE: They said colo team can provision either 2x A100S or 3x H100s. They will insist on contract-level SLA and require SOC2 + DPA. Also asked about on-call for incidents.

Sam.Security: We support BYO HSM via PKCS#11 in Private. Required deliverables: completed security questionnaire, network diagram, DPA, and SOC2 Type II report. If they demand keyless model serving semantics, we need more info; otherwise standard keywrap KMS shim works.

ops-bot: INF-7084 created: infra validation + driver check. Commands to run:
```
nvidia-smi --query-gpu=driver_version --format=csv
./validate_cuda.sh --min-version=12.1
ldconfig -p | grep pkcs11
```

Raj.SE: Cost note: 3x H100s hosted equivalent ~ $380-460/hr platform (ballpark). Private adds platform/license + managed ops. I'll prepare 10 qps estimates for both Dedicated + Private.

Maya.ML: If budget is tight propose tidal-lite (~14B distilled) which runs on 2x A100S and cuts costs ~45% with modest quality loss.

Nina.AE: Action items: I'll request env dump and the filled RFI. Raj prepare cost/SOW; Maya reserve time for conversion once infra validated. Priya will run validation ticket. Sam will send RFI checklist doc. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
